name: UltraTool
description: UltraTool is a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' capabilities in tool utilization within real-world complex scenarios. It covers the entire process from planning and creating to applying tools, emphasizing multi-step planning and natural language evaluation before tool usage.
reputation: A recent benchmark for tool-use planning and execution that has seen growing interest, but it is not yet as widely established as older agent/tool-use suites.
notes: Focuses on real-world tool usage complexity; evaluates planning independently with natural language.
